messages.content: 空调打开暖气。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "制热"}
小P空调加热。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "制热"}
车里太冷了，开暖风。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "制热"}
帮我把空调切到制热。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "制热"}
车内太热了，快速降温。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "极速降温"}
热死了，把温度调低一点。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调低", "device": "空调", "feature": "温度"}
太冷了，温度调高一点。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调高", "device": "空调", "feature": "温度"}
空调温度调高一点小P。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调高", "device": "空调", "feature": "温度"}
风小一点。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调低", "device": "空调", "feature": "风"}
调高风量。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调高", "device": "空调", "feature": "风"}
风量调大一点。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调高", "device": "空调", "feature": "风"}
风力三级。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "空调", "feature": "风", "value": "3"}
小P风量调为二档。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "空调", "feature": "风", "value": "2"}
空调风速调到二档。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "空调", "feature": "风", "value": "2"}
空调风量调到一。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "空调", "feature": "风", "value": "1"}
最大风。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "空调", "feature": "风", "value": "最高"}
把风调到最小。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "空调", "feature": "风", "value": "最低"}
风量对着我吹。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "feature": "风", "value": "对人"}
小P风不要对我吹。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "空调", "feature": "风", "value": "对人"}
外面空气不好，别让外面的风进来。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "内循环"}
打开智能除味小P。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "智能除味"}
小孩在车里，空调别停。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "守护模式"}
狗在车里，帮我看着空调别关。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "空调", "value": "宠物模式"}
关闭室内空调。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "空调", "position": "全部"}
小P全车空调开到二十四度。

Action: ClimateControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "空调", "feature": "温度", "position": "全部", "value": "24"}
座椅模式调到习惯二。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "value": "2"}
恢复成习惯一。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "复位", "feature": "习惯", "value": "1"}
用车习惯二小P。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "复位", "feature": "习惯", "value": "2"}
主驾座椅恢复到用车习惯一。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "复位", "feature": "习惯", "position": "主驾", "value": "1"}
主驾座椅恢复标准模式。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "复位", "feature": "习惯", "position": "主驾", "value": "标准模式"}
座椅回到用车习惯一。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "复位", "feature": "习惯", "value": "1"}
主驾座椅放松模式小P。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "position": "主驾", "value": "放松模式"}
小P主驾座椅调整到标准模式。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "position": "主驾", "value": "标准模式"}
座椅标准模式。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "value": "标准模式"}
副驾座椅打开标准模式。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "习惯", "position": "副驾", "value": "标准模式"}
小P副驾座椅调为标准模式。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "position": "副驾", "value": "标准模式"}
右后座椅小憩模式小P。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "position": "第二排右侧", "value": "小憩模式"}
把右后座椅调成小憩模式。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "position": "第二排右侧", "value": "小憩模式"}
打开副驾小憩模式。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "习惯", "position": "副驾", "value": "小憩模式"}
小P打开驾驶习惯一。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "习惯", "value": "1"}
保存当前主驾座椅习惯。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "保存", "feature": "习惯", "position": "主驾"}
打开主驾用车习惯。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "习惯", "position": "主驾"}
切换到下一个座椅习惯。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "value": "下一个"}
左后座椅习惯切到下一个。

Action: ProfileControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "feature": "习惯", "position": "第二排左侧", "value": "下一个"}
关闭左后车窗。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "车窗", "position": "第二排左侧"}
小P关闭左后车窗。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "车窗", "position": "第二排左侧"}
关闭右后方车窗。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "车窗", "position": "第二排右侧"}
右后窗户关上。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "车窗", "position": "第二排右侧"}
打开两个前车窗。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "车窗", "position": "前排"}
打开两个前排车窗。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "车窗", "position": "前排"}
打开主副驾车窗玻璃。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "车窗", "position": "前排"}
所有车窗开到一半。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "开到", "device": "车窗", "position": "全部", "value": "50%"}
全车车窗开一点。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "再开", "device": "车窗", "position": "全部"}
前排车窗打开百分之十。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "开到", "device": "车窗", "position": "前排", "value": "10%"}
前排车窗打开三分之一。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "开到", "device": "车窗", "position": "前排", "value": "33%"}
所有车窗打开四分之一。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "开到", "device": "车窗", "position": "全部", "value": "25%"}
前排车窗下降。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "再开", "device": "车窗", "position": "前排"}
升起全车车窗。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "再关", "device": "车窗", "position": "全部"}
升起车窗小P。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "再关", "device": "车窗"}
打开车窗通风。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "车窗"}
关掉天窗。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "遮阳帘"}
关闭幕布。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "遮阳帘"}
开天窗。

Action: WindowControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "遮阳帘"}
氛围灯设成白色。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "氛围灯", "feature": "颜色", "value": "其他"}
氛围灯调成红色。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "氛围灯", "feature": "颜色", "value": "其他"}
把氛围灯颜色改成蓝色。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "氛围灯", "feature": "颜色", "value": "其他"}
氛围灯开光剑模式。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "氛围灯", "value": "光剑"}
把氛围灯调成光剑。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "氛围灯", "value": "光剑"}
大灯切换到自动模式。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "大灯", "value": "自动"}
切换大灯模式。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "调到", "device": "大灯", "value": "下一个"}
关闭智能远光灯。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "远光灯", "value": "智能"}
前雾灯打开。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "前雾灯"}
后雾灯打开。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "后雾灯"}
主驾阅读灯打开。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "device": "阅读灯", "position": "主驾"}
副驾阅读灯关掉。

Action: LightControl
Action Input: {"action": "关闭", "device": "阅读灯", "position": "副驾"}
我想听歌。

Action: AppControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "音乐应用"}
开车无聊，来点音乐吧。

Action: AppControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "音乐应用"}
我想调一下空调参数，把面板打开。

Action: AppControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "空调"}
我想看看车辆状态。

Action: AppControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "车控"}
帮我调出行车记录的影像回放。

Action: AppControl
Action Input: {"action": "打开", "feature": "智能影像"}
